1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.g3 Bc5 4.Bg2.strategy: Completes the fianchetto: the bishop supports e4 and prepares castling, sitting behind the e4 pawn until the centre opens. White keeps a solid, flexible set-up and a slow game of manoeuvring rather than a fight for immediate gains.

1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.g3 Bc5 4.Bg2 Nc6.strategy: Develops the last knight and defends e5, finishing a compact set-up in which Black has no clear weaknesses. Neither side has committed to a pawn structure, so the game is balanced and flexible, a test of who finds the better plan.
